about: Tables 2 and 5 of arXiv:2206.14307 (Chen, Hendry, Weinberg & Feiguin), J1-J2 on the periodic 6x6 and 10x10 square lattices, PDF text extracted with pypdf. Convention check: the paper's 6x6 exact-diagonalization column agrees with the stored exact rows at J2 = 0.4, 0.7, 0.8 and 1.0 to 4.3e-7. The CNN values are quoted from Choo, Neupert & Carleo (PRB 100, 125124) and are secondary. A Lanczos step applied to a variational state is variational (RULES.md 4). Energies: S.S per site x 4N. Row notes cite this file by its earlier form, scripts/add_pdf_rows.mjs (git history).
